profile.headline: CEO of Idea Creation
profile.summary:
30+ year IT specialist wrapped in finance clothing. Inspired by the belief that the IT Services can transform at the velocity of innovative thinking.  Global proponent and practitioner of the "Future of the Feasible." 

Outside of work, you can find me enjoying golf, international travel, family time and creating custom craft cocktails with homemade bitters from edible plants and trees found in my backyard.

SPECIALTY AREAS: 
• Fintech Advisory, Recruiting and Ecosystems 
• Big IT Cloud Applications and Platforms 
• Digital Transformation, Technology Consulting, Strategy, Planning, Delivery and Support
• Large Mergers and Acquisitions
• Customer Experience, End-User Experience, Product/Solution Creation
• Commercial Banking, Cash Management and Large Derivative Capital Transactions
• Human Capital Strategy, Organizational Design, Employee Relations and Talent Management
• International Speaker and blogger on Topics such as AI, Banking Transformation, Relationship Management, Customer Experience, M&A, Fintech, etc.
